why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Yohendrick Piñango is slot #3 (4.634 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #6, #5, #7, #4, #8, #9, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.47 expected PA/game vs 4.58 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
